categories.name: Security
topActions: Review the user role assignments for 'Core.User' and ensure a 1:1 mapping
Add an XPath constraint to limit which rows 'Partners.Editor' can READ on 'Partner'
Add XPath constraints to scope access to the current user's own data, e.g. [Sales.Order_Customer/Sales.Customer/id = '[%CurrentUser%]']
Remove the CREATE and DELETE rights and implement a microflow (ACT_) with security checks

categories.name: Quality
topActions: Describe what the page shows and who reaches it.

Replace entity validation rules with a VAL_Partner microflow for explicit, testable validation

Give the page a URL — `Url: 'home_web'` on CREATE PAGE, or the URL property in Studio Pro — so it is reachable at /p/home_web. Disable CONV019 in .claude/lint-config.yaml if this app deliberately has no deep links.
